goalbuddy_receipt_v1.rationale: T098 passes its compatibility gate: exact Next.js/React versions, strict-peer installation, preservation checks, and the 101-page build receipt are present. Fumadocs is framework-compatible but remains unimplemented, with Tailwind/design-system parity absent. Current pnpm audit reports six advisories, including vulnerable PostCSS through Next 15.5.24, Playwright 1.51.1, and yaml 2.7.0. Remediate this bounded security gap first.

worker_package.objective: Upgrade only Next.js to 16.3.3, @playwright/test to 1.55.1, and yaml to 2.8.3 to remediate current advisories without overrides; preserve React 19.2.8 and all existing docs, ingestion, search, raw-route, and truthful-content behavior; record the security decision and add a CI audit gate. Do not add Fumadocs, Tailwind, or unrelated dependencies.
stop_if: Any write is needed outside allowed_files.
Any moderate, high, or critical advisory remains, or remediation requires overrides, hidden installs, or unrelated dependency churn.
Next.js 16 requires source or configuration changes outside allowed_files.
Docs, ingestion, static fallback/search, raw routes, truthful content, or build behavior regresses.
A verification command fails twice for the same in-scope cause.
Browser or build verification requires modifying an unrelated process.

evidence: T098 receipt reports exact framework upgrades, passing strict-peer install, focused docs tests, smoke tests, and a 101-page build.
Current manifests and lockfile contain Next.js 15.5.24 and React 19.2.8, with no Fumadocs or Tailwind packages.
Current audit reports vulnerable PostCSS 8.4.31, Playwright 1.51.1, and yaml 2.7.0.
Registry metadata shows Next 16.3.3 uses patched PostCSS 8.5.23; Playwright 1.55.1 and yaml 2.8.3 meet patched floors.
Current routes, content, docs, SEO, security, performance, rollback, and formatting checks pass.
Current reports and launch evidence remain stale relative to T098; external, Lighthouse, SBOM, and legal/factual evidence remain open.

parallel_safety.reason: Shared framework manifests, lockfile, CI, and application-wide verification require one sole Worker.

missing_evidence: Fresh launch/readiness reports, Lighthouse, SBOM, synthetic-monitor, rollback, provider, deployment, legal, and factual evidence.
